purpose: Planned refresh cadence for the external-first trend-intelligence program.
rule: A refresh updates the pinned artifact and reruns normalization, lineage review, comparison challenge, promotion gates, and release validation. A schedule does not imply that a source is continuously available or independent.

families.cadence: on source-record commit and monthly audit
families.trigger: new source-backed record, revision, or counter-signal
new atlas, collection manifest, or approved source snapshot
new deep-trend synthesis, falsifier, or input checksum set
new filing, earnings period, theme-map revision, or source-owner correction

families.cadence: annual release and quarterly evidence refresh
families.trigger: new ranking release, source-linked company evidence, or field-validation result
new industry record, force register, finding, or falsifier
new custody, deduplication, rights, or verification contract

families.cadence: on identity, comparability, rights, or release-contract revision
families.trigger: governance contract changes the permitted bridge or review state
